1.consolidated_definition: Ser una persona cariñosa, dulce en su trato. “El novio de tu hija es un melao con todo el mundo; da gusto ir a su negocio.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To be a person who is affectionate and sweet in one's dealings with others. "The boyfriend of your daughter is a melao with everyone; it's a pleasure to go to his business."
